name: metrora-desktop
description: Metrora Desktop — local-first AI usage intelligence

scripts.build: npm run brand:assets && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run stage-cli && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.package: npm run stage-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:arm64: npm run stage-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:x64: npm run stage-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.package:win: npm run stage-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:linux: npm run stage-cli && npm run build && electron-builder --linux

extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Metrora reads local AI coding tool session logs to calculate token usage and cost. Prompt and response bodies are not exported by default.
